quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: It is tempting to read Naila's much-publicized digital detox, during which she claims to have abstained entirely from social media for a full year, as a straightforward story of disciplined abstinence, yet a more precise account reveals a considerably more qualified reality involving several exceptions she quietly made for coordinating with family and for a single professional networking platform tied to her freelance income.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the straightforward story people assumed.
quests.explanation: The passage says disciplined abstinence, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Revealingly, the certification board's public statement attributing this year's notably higher pass rate entirely to a revised, more effective study guide omits a detail that internal minutes from the board's own quality committee make explicit: a quiet recalibration of the passing threshold occurred during the same cycle, after psychometricians had privately flagged the previous standard as miscalibrated for two consecutive years.
quests.hint: Find what quietly occurred to the passing threshold.
quests.explanation: The passage says a recalibration occurred, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The company's official account of its remarkably smooth transition to a four-day work week, frequently cited by executives as proof of the model's viability, tends to omit a detail documented in internal planning memos: the pilot was deliberately limited to departments whose work was least dependent on real-time coordination with external clients across differing time zones.
quests.hint: Find what executives say the smooth transition proves.
quests.explanation: The passage says it proves viability, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The regional airline's public statement crediting its recently overhauled boarding procedure with a measurable reduction in average flight delays elides a detail documented in the same internal operations report the airline's own press release selectively quotes: the reduction coincided almost precisely with a separate decision to reduce connecting itineraries through its most delay-prone regional hub.
quests.hint: Find the word meaning the statement leaves out a key detail.
quests.explanation: The passage says the statement elides it, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Unsurprisingly, the widely shared account of how Naila's grandparents met, a story recounted at nearly every family gathering as a serendipitous chance encounter at a train station, was substantially revised after a cousin doing genealogical research uncovered a bundle of letters revealing a formal introduction through a mutual family friend nearly a year before that supposedly chance meeting.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the chance encounter in the family story.
quests.explanation: The passage says a serendipitous encounter, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The furniture retailer's advertising campaign touting its bestselling sofa model as having an average customer satisfaction rating substantially higher than industry norms is based on a survey methodology that, according to a disclosure required after a competitor's complaint, only surveys customers within thirty days of purchase, a window that predates when most structural complaints about the frame typically arise.
quests.hint: Find what type of survey approach the rating is based on.
quests.explanation: The passage says a survey methodology, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The celebrated chef's frequently repeated origin story, in which she credits a single transformative meal at a now-closed restaurant during her twenties as the sole catalyst for her decision to pursue cooking professionally, was complicated when an early mentor, interviewed separately for a culinary history project, revealed she had already been informally apprenticing in her kitchen for nearly a year beforehand.
quests.hint: Find what the single meal was described as being for her decision.
quests.explanation: The passage says the sole catalyst, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Notably, the technology company's public statement attributing this year's significant reduction in customer-reported data breaches entirely to its newly implemented encryption protocol omits a detail documented in a separate internal audit conducted by the company's own security team: the same period also saw the quiet discontinuation of a legacy authentication method responsible for a disproportionate share of prior breaches.
quests.hint: Find what type of protocol the company newly implemented.
quests.explanation: The passage says an encryption protocol, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the wellness company's marketing for its popular sleep supplement cites a specific clinical study as evidence of effectiveness, a closer examination of that same publicly available study reveals the tested dosage was substantially higher than what is actually contained in the commercially sold product, and that the study population excluded anyone taking other common medications.
quests.hint: Find what was found to be substantially higher in the study.
quests.explanation: The passage says the tested dosage, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The film studio's public narrative crediting the blockbuster's unexpected box office success entirely to an innovative, purely digital marketing campaign that has since been studied across the industry omits a detail confirmed in the studio's own financial disclosures to shareholders: a substantial, largely undisclosed portion of the budget was allocated to traditional television advertising during the campaign's final two weeks.
quests.hint: Find what type of shareholder documents confirmed the omitted detail.
quests.explanation: The passage says financial disclosures, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although a particular species of tree frog is frequently cited in popular science writing as being able to survive being completely frozen solid during winter and simply thaw out unharmed in spring, researchers studying the species more closely have found that a small percentage of cells, particularly in certain organ tissues, do not survive the freezing process at all.
quests.hint: Find how the frog is popularly described as thawing out.
quests.explanation: The passage says it thaws out unharmed, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The city's public statement attributing the notable decline in downtown vacancy rates entirely to its recently introduced small-business tax incentive program omits a detail present in the city's own economic development office data: the decline coincided closely with a large employer's decision, made for unrelated internal real estate reasons, to relocate hundreds of employees downtown.
quests.hint: Find what type of rates notably declined downtown.
quests.explanation: The passage says vacancy rates, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Farid's decade-long habit of tracking every expenditure down to the cent, a practice he has described in interviews as the single most transformative financial habit he adopted in his twenties, is often cited by admirers as evidence that meticulous tracking alone produces meaningful savings, though he himself now admits the habit coincided almost exactly with a substantial raise at his job.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the type of tracking admirers credit.
quests.explanation: The passage says meticulous tracking, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Interestingly, although the university's press release describing its new writing-intensive general education requirement emphasizes the substantial increase in overall student writing output as evidence of success, a more granular analysis conducted by the assessment office found the quality improvement was concentrated almost entirely among students also enrolled in a small, oversubscribed peer-tutoring program running concurrently.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the more detailed analysis conducted.
quests.explanation: The passage says a more granular analysis, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the manufacturing plant's leadership has publicly credited its recently implemented peer-mentorship program with the substantial year-over-year decline in workplace injuries, a closer look at the incident data reveals the decline began several months before the program's actual rollout date, coinciding instead with the replacement of a specific piece of aging machinery.
quests.hint: Find what the decline began before, according to the data.
quests.explanation: The passage says the program's rollout date, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the historic railway's marketing describes its restored vintage locomotive as running on the exact original nineteenth-century engineering specifications, a technical disclosure filed with the regional heritage rail authority for safety certification purposes reveals that the boiler and braking systems were substantially modernized during restoration, with only the locomotive's exterior remaining faithful to the original design.
quests.hint: Find what the marketing claims the locomotive runs on.
quests.explanation: The passage says the original specifications, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The frequently repeated family narrative crediting Marcus's grandfather's business success entirely to his individual ingenuity and hard work, a story Marcus has recounted proudly in his own professional networking, was complicated considerably when Marcus discovered documentation of a substantial loan from a wealthy in-law used to establish the business initially.
quests.hint: Find what the grandfather's success was originally credited to.
quests.explanation: The passage says individual ingenuity, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the online marketplace's public statements have consistently framed its recently introduced seller verification badge as a straightforward quality signal reflecting product reliability, an investigation by a consumer protection organization found the badge's underlying criteria were based almost entirely on shipping speed and message response time, with no requirement relating to defect rates.
quests.hint: Find what type of badge the marketplace introduced for sellers.
quests.explanation: The passage says a verification badge, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The beverage company's marketing claim that its popular sports drink formula has remained essentially unchanged since its original nineteen-sixties formulation, a detail heavily featured in nostalgic advertising, is contradicted by the company's own regulatory filings across several decades, which document at least six documented reformulations, including substantial changes to sugar content.
quests.hint: Find what the regulatory filings document at least six of.
quests.explanation: The passage says six documented reformulations, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the smartphone manufacturer's marketing has consistently described its facial recognition unlock feature as functionally equivalent in security to a physical fingerprint sensor, an independent security research team's published findings demonstrated the facial system could be circumvented under specific and admittedly narrow conditions involving a sufficiently detailed photograph, conditions the fingerprint sensor tested alongside it could not.
quests.hint: Find what the independent research showed could happen to the system.
quests.explanation: The passage says it could be circumvented, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The hospital network's public statement crediting its recently introduced patient-navigator program with the substantial improvement in appointment adherence among chronic disease patients does not mention that the same period saw a separate, unrelated rollout of automated text-message reminders an internal analysis found accounted for a comparable share of the improvement.
quests.hint: Find what type of improvement the program is credited with.
quests.explanation: The passage says appointment adherence, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the streaming platform's press releases describing the record-breaking viewership of its flagship original series rely on a specific metric the platform itself defines, one that counts any viewer who streamed at least two minutes as having watched the title, a leaked internal document revealed the average viewer watched considerably less than half the season by a more conventional completion measure.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the more standard way of measuring completion.
quests.explanation: The passage says a more conventional measure, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The frequently repeated claim that a specific species of ancient tree is the single oldest living organism on Earth, a title applied loosely across popular science media, is complicated by a taxonomic dispute among biologists regarding whether certain clonal colonial organisms sharing a single root system spanning thousands of stems should be considered a single organism at all.
quests.hint: Find what type of dispute complicates the claim among biologists.
quests.explanation: The passage says a taxonomic dispute, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the transit authority's public messaging surrounding its new express bus route has emphasized substantial ridership growth as clear evidence of success, a framing used to justify requests for additional funding, a more detailed internal analysis found many riders had previously used a now-discontinued local route entirely.
quests.hint: Find what type of growth the transit authority emphasized.
quests.explanation: The passage says ridership growth, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although Camille's morning journaling practice is frequently described, including by Camille herself in earlier interviews, as a twenty-minute ritual completed first thing upon waking, a closer look at the timestamps in her own journaling app reveals that on most days, the entry is actually completed sometime between her first and second cup of coffee.
quests.hint: Find what revealed the messier pattern in her journaling app.
quests.explanation: The passage says the timestamps revealed it, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Contrary to how the vocational school's recruitment materials characterize its accelerated welding certificate as equivalent in rigor to the standard eighteen-month program merely compressed into eight months, an independent review comparing graduates of both tracks found accelerated-track graduates scored measurably lower on tasks requiring troubleshooting judgment rather than straightforward technique execution.
quests.hint: Find what type of tasks accelerated graduates scored lower on.
quests.explanation: The passage says troubleshooting judgment, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The consulting firm's marketing materials describing its proprietary framework as having driven a specific percentage improvement in client efficiency across engagements rest on a calculation methodology that, according to a footnote in the firm's own case study documentation, averages results only across clients who completed the full engagement and consented to inclusion.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the firm's framework in its marketing.
quests.explanation: The passage says its proprietary framework, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The popular claim, repeated across numerous travel blogs and even some tour operator materials, that the ancient bridge in question has remained structurally unchanged since its original construction over a thousand years ago is directly contradicted by conservation records held by the site's own heritage authority, which document at least four substantial reconstructions following flood damage.
quests.hint: Find what the conservation records document at least four of.
quests.explanation: The passage says four substantial reconstructions, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although Priya's parents have long described their decision to immigrate as driven purely by a desire to provide better educational opportunities for their children, a recent conversation prompted by a family history project revealed that the decision actually predated the birth of any of their children entirely.
quests.hint: Find what the decision did relative to the children's births.
quests.explanation: The passage says the decision predated their births, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The grocery chain's repeated public assurances that its recently introduced dynamic shelf pricing technology would never result in higher prices for the same item within a single shopping visit were directly contradicted by an independent price-tracking investigation documenting multiple instances of exactly that discrepancy occurring during a single customer visit.
quests.hint: Find what the grocery chain repeatedly made about its pricing.
quests.explanation: The passage says repeated public assurances, so that is correct.
